items.title: 全球長債殖利率飆升！結構性通膨來襲 資產配置邏輯重新洗牌
paras: 全球政府公債近期遭遇劇烈拋售，凸顯投資人對宏觀經濟環境可能轉向「通膨持續偏高」的疑慮，而各國政府難以遏制支出與主權債務增加，更進一步加深市場疑慮。
殖利率面臨的上升壓力，不只來自政府借款增加與能源價格上漲。投資人指出，全球化轉向保護主義、地緣政治緊張升高，並進一步反映在關稅、產業回流與國防支出增加等面向，都是更廣泛結構性轉變的跡象，可能導致通膨長期居高不下。
這將代表全球在金融危機後大致維持低檔且相對穩定的通膨環境將出現重大分水嶺，也將對投資人的投資組合帶來廣泛影響。
已開發國家的長天期公債殖利率，本周紛紛觸及多年或數十年高點：美國10年期公債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水準，日本10年期公債殖利率升破3%，為1996年以來首見，英國10年期公債殖利率創2008年金融危機以來新高，歐元區借貸成本的指標、德國10年期公債殖利率，也升至2011年以來未見水準。
CG資產管理公司投資組合經理Emma Moriarty說：「全球經濟的結構性特徵已經改變，現在產生的是推升通膨、而非壓低通膨的力量。」
她指出，「關稅，以及最近爆發的中東戰爭，都是這項秩序轉變最直接的表現。以為能源衝擊只是暫時現象的想法是錯誤的，因為造成這項衝擊的根本結構性變化，可能會持續相當長時間。」
「失控」公共債務終將反噬
JM Finn投資辦公室主管Jon Cunliffe表示，儘管周期性通膨壓力可能持續降溫，投資人不應假設經濟將重返2010年至2020年間那種通膨長期偏低且穩定的環境。
Cunliffe說，目前最大的未知數，在於人工智慧(AI)大幅提升生產力後，能對通膨產生多大的抑制作用——這正是新任聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)所寄望的。
Callanish Capital執行長Haig Bathgate表示，政府支出「不斷失控」，總有一天會反過來造成問題，「回顧1970年代的歷史，一旦通膨這個精靈被放出瓶子，就很難再把它塞回去。我們面臨的通膨持續時間比任何人原先想像的都更長。」

央行面臨棘手難題

各國央行在利率走勢上面臨日益複雜的挑戰。一方面，通膨仍容易受到供應面衝擊與地緣政治因素干擾，另一方面，在經濟成長疲弱之際，決策官員又不願大幅升息。
Cunliffe表示，「在這種情況下，英國央行(BOE)與Fed可能會容忍通膨暫時超標，同時觀察是否出現第二輪工資與價格效應。」
其他地區情況不同，Cunliffe指出，「歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BOJ，央行)則處於更明確的升息路徑。前者將通膨置於經濟成長之上，而後者則因經濟成長與通膨已站穩腳步，正走向貨幣政策正常化。」
在華許8月28日在美國懷俄明州傑克遜霍爾發表主題演說後，市場對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月15-16日升息的押注一度升至逾66%，遠高於演說前約35%。
ING美洲區研究主管暨全球利率與債務策略主管Padhraic Garvey表示，伊朗戰爭與高昂能源成本，為長天期公債殖利率帶來額外的上升壓力。這對歐洲而言尤其是一個迫在眉睫的問題，對亞洲以及其他地區也是如此。
Garvey說：「如果現在音樂停止，對許多發債機構而言，長天期殖利率的絕對水準看起來還算合理。但問題在於，音樂仍在轟鳴。」
他如此形容：「市場上有太多事情正在發生，而大多數壓力仍持續指向長天期利率走高。這不一定會演變成危機，但如果壓力被推得太遠，情況也可能失控。」
Garvey補充，「很難想像長天期殖利率走高的壓力會突然奇蹟般消失。」
他表示，市場對9月FOMC會議升息1碼(25個基點)的定價，已從大約五五波，轉變為三比一明顯偏向升息。

投資組合配置改變

債券殖利率飆升，也正在重新塑造投資人的投資組合配置。
Ninety One多資產收益主管John Stopford表示，通膨波動加劇，往往會提高股市與債市之間的相關性，降低債市在平衡型投資組合中的分散風險效益。
不過他指出，「實質利率上升會推高資本成本，也可能讓債券成為更具競爭力的資產類別，尤其是在股市估值看來偏高的情況下。」
Barings全球固定收益團隊執行董事Brian Mangwiro則表示，政府債券基金應採取防禦性配置，偏向存續期較短的債券。
他說：「多策略固定收益基金也可以聚焦較高收益，但同樣應偏向較短存續期。就美國而言，美國公債遭拋售以及殖利率曲線持續陡峭化，也與美元走弱的情況一致。這通常對新興市場構成利多。」

items.title: 比特幣多頭夢醒？非農強勁引爆Fed升息警報 才站回8萬美元又被打下來
items.title_en: Bitcoin Bull Dream Wakes? Strong Jobs Data Triggers Fed Rate Hike Alarm, Reaches $80K Only to Fall Again
paras: 美國8月非農就業數據大幅超越預期，重新點燃聯準會(Fed)9月升息押注，比特幣周五(4日)一度下跌近3%，迅速回吐前一日漲幅，再度跌破8萬美元關卡。
比特幣盤中最多下跌2.8%，觸及79,197美元，與美股及債券同步承壓。美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，高於《彭博》調查中所有經濟學家的預測；失業率則維持在4.1%，顯示勞動市場動能比市場原先認為更加強勁。
截稿前，根據CoinGecko數據，比特幣交易價格在24小時內下跌0.5%，報79,432.82美元。
數據公布後，投資人提高Fed本月升息的押注，對貨幣政策較敏感的2年期美債殖利率走高，美元也隨之升值。利率上升會提高持有美元資產的吸引力，並壓抑比特幣等本身不孳息的風險資產。
這波跌勢也使比特幣能否能否否站穩8萬美元再度面臨總體經濟考驗。比特幣周四才重新突破這道關卡，當 thanks to 美債殖利率下降及美元走弱，風險資產獲得支撐。
Fed理事hlweni華 comet勒(Christopher Waller)先前表示，若通膨持續降溫，他將支持本月維持利率不變，當時一度壓低市場升息預期。然而，最新就業報告明顯轉重塑投資人對Fed政策gpt0決策gpt0前景的判斷。
Sygnum Bank投資長Fabian Dori表示，單一月份的明顯反彈仍不足以終結利率爭論，卻會為支持升息的鷹派官員提供更多 ammunition，強勁數據也驗證市場目前對9月升息機率的定價。
不過，他指出，比特幣的走勢並非只取決於Fed短期決策，美國財政部現金餘額、銀行資產負債表承受能力、私人信用創造及穩定幣供應等流動性因素，也會各自影響加密貨幣市場。
paras_en: U.S. August nonfarm payrolls vastly exceeded expectations, reigniting bets on a September Fed rate hike; Bitcoin fell nearly 3% on Friday the 4th, quickly erasing the previous day's gains and slipping back below the $80,000 barrier.

Bitcoin dropped as much as 2.8% intraday, touching $79,197, while U.S. equities and bonds were under pressure. August nonfarm payrolls rose by 162,000, above the forecasts of all economists surveyed by Bloomberg; the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, indicating labor‑market momentum stronger than the market had assumed.
At the time of writing, CoinGecko data showed Bitcoin’s price had fallen 0.5% over the past 24 hours, trading at $79,432.82.

After the data release, investors increased bets on a Fed rate hike this month, pushing 2‑year Treasury yields higher and lifting the dollar. Higher rates make dollar‑denominated assets more attractive and suppress risk assets like Bitcoin that yield no income.

This decline also put Bitcoin’s ability to stay above $80,000 under renewed macro‑economic scrutiny. Bitcoin had only reclaimed the level on Thursday, thanks to falling Treasury yields and a weaker dollar that supported risk assets.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller previously said that if inflation continued to cool he would support keeping rates unchanged this month, which had temporarily lowered market expectations for a hike. However, the latest jobs report clearly reshaped investors’ view of the Fed’s policy outlook.

Sygnum Bank’s Chief Investment Officer Fabian Dori said that a single month’s clear rebound is not enough to end the rate‑debate, but it will give hawkish officials more ammunition to support hikes, and the strong data validates the market’s pricing of a September hike probability.

He added that Bitcoin’s trajectory is not solely driven by short‑term Fed decisions; liquidity factors such as the U.S. Treasury’s cash balance, banks’ balance‑sheet capacity, private credit creation, and stablecoin supply also independently affect the cryptocurrency market.

items.title: 強勁非農幫Fed壯膽？傳聲筒：升息最後障礙只剩下周CPI
items.title_en: Strong Nonfarm Payrolls Boost Fed Confidence? The Last Hurdle to a Rate Hike Is Next Week’s CPI
paras: 美國8月非農就業數據大幅超越預期，雖然不足以直接促使聯準會(Fed)升息，卻掃除了反對本月升息的一項重要理由。素有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的《華爾街日報》記者Nick Timiraos周五(4日)撰文指出，Fed在9月15日至16日會議是否升息，如今將主要取決於下周公布的通膨數據。
Fed官員先前已表明，在今年持續按兵不動後，通膨走勢將是決定9月是否升息的首要因素。假如8月就業報告延續7月的負成長，官員便可主張，不應在勞動市場缺乏動能時進一步收緊貨幣政策。
然而，美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，遠超市場預期，7月數據也由原先減少2.3萬人上修為增加2.1萬人，使過去6個月平均就業增幅升至逾兩年最高。勞動市場疲弱因此不再是反對升息的有力理由。
Nick Timiraos強調，「移除一項反對升息的理由」，並不等於已經「建立升息的充分依據」。Fed官員目前並不認為勞動市場是主要通膨來源，薪資成長仍屬溫和，也沒有必要刻意壓低招聘活動以促使物價回落。
不過，就業與所得持續穩定成長，顯示目前利率對經濟的抑制作用可能相當有限，甚至幾乎沒有發揮效果，也使Fed必須重新思考現行政策是否足以讓通膨降溫。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，健康的勞動市場不會是他決定利率時的主要因素，但仍是評估貨幣政策是否足以降低通膨的重要背景。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周也表示，他很難將整體金融情勢形容為具有限制性。
強勁就業同時降低Fed升息的潛在代價。若下周公布的8月通膨數據促使官員傾向升息，他們採取行動時，將較不必擔心進一步緊縮會把原本脆弱的勞動市場推向惡化。
換言之，非農報告並未讓Fed非升息不可，卻讓官員少了一個不能升息的理由。隨著就業疑慮退居次要位置，下周公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)等通膨數據，將成為決定Fed本月是否出手的最後關卡。
paras_en: The U.S. August nonfarm payrolls data far exceeded expectations, and while it is not enough on its own to compel the Federal Reserve (Fed) to raise rates, it has removed a key argument against a rate hike this month. Nick Timiraos, a Wall Street Journal reporter often dubbed the “Fed’s mouthpiece,” wrote on Friday the 4th that the Fed’s decision on whether to raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting will now hinge primarily on the inflation data to be released next week.

Fed officials have previously indicated that after a year of holding rates steady, the trajectory of inflation will be the primary factor in deciding whether to raise rates in September. If the August jobs report had continued July’s negative growth, officials could argue that further tightening is unwarranted when labor‑market momentum is lacking.

However, August nonfarm employment rose by 162,000 jobs, far above market forecasts, and July’s figure was revised from a loss of 23,000 to a gain of 21,000, pushing the six‑month average job growth to its highest level in more than two years. A weak labor market is therefore no longer a strong argument against a rate hike.

Timiraos stresses that “removing one reason to oppose a rate hike” does not equate to having “sufficient grounds to raise rates.” Fed officials currently do not view the labor market as the main source of inflation; wage growth remains modest, and there is no need to deliberately suppress hiring activity to bring prices down.

Nevertheless, continued steady growth in employment and earnings suggests that the current interest‑rate stance may be exerting only limited, if any, restraint on the economy, prompting the Fed to reconsider whether its policy is adequate to cool inflation.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that a healthy labor market will not be a primary factor in his rate‑setting decisions, though it remains an important backdrop for assessing whether monetary policy is sufficient to lower inflation. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh also said last week that he finds it difficult to characterize overall financial conditions as restrictive.

Robust employment also lowers the potential cost of a Fed rate hike. If next week’s August inflation data push officials toward a hike, they can act with less concern that further tightening will push an already fragile labor market into deterioration.

In other words, the jobs report has not made a Fed rate hike inevitable, but it has removed one obstacle to raising rates. With employment concerns now secondary, the consumer‑price index (CPI) and other inflation data due next week will become the final gatekeeper in deciding whether the Fed will act this month.

items.title: Fed本月升不升息？華爾街從強勁非農看出三大關鍵
items.title_en: Will the Fed Raise Rates This Month? Wall Street Deduces Three Key Points from Strong Nonfarm Payrolls
paras: 美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，大幅超越市場預期的5.6萬人，顯示勞動市場動能比原先認為更強，也讓華爾街重新評估聯準會(Fed)本月升息的可能性。數據公布後，市場對Fed兩周後升息1碼(25個基點)的預期由52%升至59%。
華爾街分析師的解讀主要聚焦三大關鍵：第一，強勁就業是否足以促使Fed升息，還是溫和的薪資增幅仍支持按兵不動；第二，資訊與金融業就業偏弱、營建及製造業相對強勁，是否反映AI一邊取代部分白領工作，一邊透過資料中心投資創造實體產業需求；第三，亮眼數據背後仍存在季節調整、後續修正及長期失業人口增加等隱憂。
分析師對升息與否看法分歧，但較一致的結論是，下周公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)才是Fed本月利率決策的最終關鍵。8月失業率維持在4.1%，7月非農就業也由原先減少2.3萬人上修為增加2.1萬人，進一步削弱勞動市場正在快速惡化的論點；若通膨未能明顯降溫，Fed升息理由將更加充分，反之仍有繼續按兵不動的空間。

升息派與按兵不動派交鋒 關鍵仍是下周通膨

CFRA Research首席投資策略師Sam Stovall表示，就業增幅超過預期3倍，讓Fed的決策更加複雜。由於就業數據明顯改善，Fed如今有更多升息的理由，或者至少更難為維持利率不變辯護，這正是股市轉跌的原因。
Wells Fargo Investment Institute全球策略師Gary Schlossberg認為，這份報告證明美國經濟帶著相當強勁的動能度過夏季，也使下周消費者物價指數(CPI)承受更大壓力。若物價顯示通膨重新升溫，Fed在9月16日升息的可能性將進一步提高。
Natixis美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge也指出，多數決策官員原本就未對勞動市場感到擔憂，因此近期政策仍將主要由通膨主導。除非核心CPI月增率降至約0.2%，為鴿派提供繼續按兵不動的理由，否則Fed很可能在9月升息。
Harris Financial Group管理合夥人Jamie Cox則持相反看法。他認為，這份數據雖可能讓部分Fed官員主張提高短期利率，但整體資料支持維持利率不變，而不是升息。
Spartan Capital Securities首席市場經濟學家Peter Cardillo也表示，就業反彈證明勞動市場相當穩健，但平均時薪年增3.1%並未顯示薪資通膨正在惡化。若下周CPI與生產者物價指數(PPI)大致延續前幾個月趨勢，他預期Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)仍會選擇按兵不動。

產業增減透露AI衝擊 資料中心創造另一波需求

Hirtle & Co.投資長Brad Conger認為，就業報告證實華許所稱Fed暫時不必擔心充分就業目標的判斷。相較總數，產業組成更值得關注，因為其中可能已浮現AI取代人力的輪廓。
他指出，AI採用程度較高的資訊及金融業就業表現偏弱，負責建造、配置設備及供應資料中心能源的營建、製造與公用事業部門則相對強勁。這種變化可能支撐K型經濟中收入較弱勢族群的所得，意味AI一方面取代部分白領工作，另一方面也透過資料中心投資創造實體產業需求。
Gary Schlossberg表示，市場先前將部分就業疲弱歸因於企業導入AI後生產力提高，但8月報告顯示，美國經濟動能並未因此明顯消失。不過，油價上漲仍可能壓縮家庭所得並拖累消費，而目前消費支出雖不突出，仍是支撐美國經濟的重要力量。
Cresalta Investment Management投資長Josh Stevens也認為，就業數據顯示美國經濟重新朝正面方向發展。伊朗戰爭一度打亂年初動能，但目前看來部分成長力道已經回歸。若未來幾個月就業持續強勁並帶動薪資加速，才會真正引起Fed警戒。

別只看亮眼表面 修正與長期失業仍藏隱憂

Innovator ETFs首席投資策略師Tim Urbanowicz表示，市場短期內可能採取「先反應、稍後再提問」的態度，但待情緒平復後，投資人可能發現勞動市場逐步恢復平衡的整體趨勢仍未改變。
Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen則說，7月就業人口下滑如今證明只是錯覺，凸顯投資人僅根據初值交易的風險，因為數據日後可能大幅修正。地方政府教育部門先前的下降，也可能只是季節調整造成的假象。
他表示，8月總工時與總薪資均穩健成長，勞動參與率也有所改善，但單月勞動人口大增68.3萬人，令人質疑季節調整是否準確。
報告也並非毫無隱憂。失業27周以上的長期失業人口增加15.9萬人，顯示「不招聘、也不裁員」的就業市場雖對已有工作者相對有利，失業者要重新進入職場卻更加困難。
華爾街目前的共同看法是，非農報告已排除Fed因勞動市場急速惡化而按兵不動的理由，但尚不足以單獨決定利率方向。下周CPI將成為真正的決勝點：若通膨偏熱，9月升息可能成為主流預期；若物價明顯降溫，Fed仍有維持利率不變的空間。
paras_en: U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose by 162,000 in August, far exceeding the market expectation of 56,000, indicating labor‑market momentum is stronger than previously thought and prompting Wall Street to reassess the likelihood of a Fed rate hike this month. After the data release, the market’s probability that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter‑point (25 basis points) in two weeks rose from 52% to 59%.

Wall Street analysts focus on three key issues: first, whether the robust job gains are enough to push the Fed to hike rates or whether modest wage growth still supports a hold; second, whether weaker employment in information‑technology and finance versus relatively stronger construction and manufacturing reflects AI displacing some white‑collar jobs while data‑center investment creates demand in the real‑economy sector; third, the bright headline numbers still hide concerns such as seasonal adjustments, future revisions, and a rise in long‑term unemployment.

Analysts are split on whether the Fed will hike, but they largely agree that next week’s consumer price index (CPI) will be the decisive factor for the Fed’s rate decision this month. August’s unemployment rate held at 4.1%, and July’s nonfarm payrolls were revised from a loss of 23,000 to a gain of 21,000, further weakening the argument that the labor market is deteriorating rapidly. If inflation does not cool noticeably, the case for a Fed hike strengthens; otherwise, there remains room to keep rates unchanged.

The debate between hawks and doves hinges on next week’s inflation data. Sam Stovall, chief investment strategist at CFRA Research, said the job growth, which far exceeded expectations, makes the Fed’s decision more complex. With such a clear improvement in employment, the Fed now has more reasons to raise rates—or at least finds it harder to justify keeping rates steady, which is why equities have turned lower.

Gary Schlossberg, global strategist at Wells Fargo Investment Institute, believes the report shows the U.S. economy carried strong momentum through the summer, putting additional pressure on next week’s CPI. If prices indicate that inflation is heating up again, the odds of a Fed hike on September 16 will rise further.

Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, noted that most policymakers were not originally worried about the labor market, so recent policy will continue to be driven mainly by inflation. Unless core CPI’s monthly rise falls to about 0.2%, giving dovish policymakers a reason to stay on hold, the Fed is likely to hike in September.

Jamie Cox, managing partner at Harris Financial Group, takes the opposite view. He thinks the data may lead some Fed officials to argue for a higher short‑term rate, but the overall picture supports keeping rates unchanged rather than raising them.

Peter Cardillo, chief market economist at Spartan Capital Securities, said the jobs rebound shows the labor market is fairly solid, but the 3.1% year‑over‑year increase in average hourly earnings does not signal worsening wage inflation. If next week’s CPI and producer price index (PPI) roughly follow recent trends, he expects Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to stay on hold.

Industry shifts reveal AI’s impact, with data‑center demand creating a new wave of needs. Brad Conger, chief investment officer at Hirtle & Co., said the jobs report confirms Warsh’s view that the Fed does not need to worry about meeting its full‑employment goal for now. The composition of employment is more telling than the headline total because it may already show AI‑driven labor displacement.

He pointed out that employment in information‑technology and finance—sectors with higher AI adoption—was weaker, while construction, manufacturing and utilities that build, equip and power data centers were relatively strong. This shift could support income for the weaker side of a K‑shaped recovery, meaning AI replaces some white‑collar jobs while also spurring real‑economy demand through data‑center investment.

Schlossberg added that the market previously blamed weaker employment on productivity gains from AI adoption, but the August report shows that overall U.S. economic momentum has not vanished. However, higher oil prices could still squeeze household incomes and dampen consumption, and although consumer spending is not currently a standout, it remains a key engine for the U.S. economy.

Josh Stevens, chief investment officer at Cresalta Investment Management, said the jobs data indicate the U.S. economy is moving back toward a positive trajectory. The Iran conflict once disrupted early‑year momentum, but now some growth drivers appear to be returning. Only if employment stays strong and accelerates wage growth in the coming months will the Fed become truly alarmed.

Don’t focus only on the shiny surface; revisions and long‑term unemployment still hide risks. Tim Urbanowicz, chief investment strategist at Innovator ETFs, said the market may initially “react first, question later,” but once sentiment cools investors may realize that the broader trend of the labor market gradually rebalancing has not changed.

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, noted that the July dip in employment was an illusion, highlighting the risk of trading on preliminary figures because the data can be substantially revised later. The earlier drop in local‑government education employment may also have been a seasonal artifact.

He said August’s total hours worked and total wages grew robustly, and the labor‑force participation rate improved, but the single‑month surge of 683,000 workers raises questions about the accuracy of seasonal adjustments.

The report also carries concerns. Long‑term unemployment—people out of work for 27 weeks or more—rose by 159,000, showing that a “no hiring, no layoffs” market may benefit those already employed while making it harder for the unemployed to re‑enter the workforce.

Wall Street’s consensus view is that the nonfarm payrolls have removed the argument that a rapidly deteriorating labor market would force the Fed to stay on hold, but the data alone are insufficient to set the rate path. Next week’s CPI will be the true decisive point: if inflation stays hot, a September hike becomes the prevailing expectation; if prices cool markedly, the Fed still has room to keep rates unchanged.

items.title: 非農爆強仍要降息！川普警告Fed不降就拿貿易逆差國開刀
items.title_en: Nonfarm Payrolls Surge Yet He Still Demands Rate Cuts! Trump Warns Fed That If It Doesn't Cut, He’ll Target Trade-Deficit Countries
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周五(4日)在自家社群平台Truth Social發文，盛讚美國8月非農就業數據遠超市場預期，並再次施壓聯準會(Fed)降息。他甚至揚言，若Fed不降低利率，美國將停止與美方存在貿易逆差的國家進行貿易。
美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，不僅超越所有市場預測，更達《路透》調查預估5.6萬人的近3倍。川普宣稱，這項數據「突破所有預測，除了我的預測」，並表示美國經濟的真正實力尚未完全展現。
不過，強勁就業數據促使交易員提高Fed本月升息的押注，與川普要求降息的立場形成鮮明對比。
川普指出，美國如今是比不久前更強大的信用體，因此理應享有更低的利率。他強調，「強大的國家意味著更低的利率，因為它是更優良的信用」，美國甚至應像「過去的美好年代」一樣，擁有全球最低利率。
他還把利率政策與貿易逆差連結，警告若Fed不降息，將停止與美國對其存在貿易逆差的國家進行貿易，並聲稱這種做法「比關稅更好」。川普也宣稱，美國最高法院在關稅判決中，已明確認可總統擁有這項權力。
川普最後要求Fed理事會及主席華許(Kevin Warsh)「聰明一點」，並呼籲官員「當一次愛國者」。他批評，高利率使美國處於極不公平的競爭劣勢，強調自己不會允許這種情況持續。
有分析認為，川普將強勁經濟等同於更低利率，與央行通常為防止通膨而維持高利率的邏輯相反；如今他更把降息與貿易掛鉤，不僅加劇政策不確定性，也讓Fed獨立性再次面臨考驗。
paras_en: President Donald Trump posted on his Truth Social platform on Friday the 4th, praising the August U.S. nonfarm payrolls numbers for far exceeding market expectations and once again pressuring the Federal Reserve to cut rates. He even warned that if the Fed does not lower interest rates, the United States will cease trading with countries that run a trade deficit with the U.S.

August nonfarm payrolls rose by 162,000 jobs, not only surpassing all market forecasts but reaching nearly three times Reuters’ estimate of 56,000. Trump declared the data “breaks all forecasts except my own” and said the true strength of the U.S. economy has not yet been fully revealed.
However, the strong employment data prompted traders to increase bets on a Fed rate hike this month, a stark contrast to Trump’s demand for cuts.

Trump argued that the United States is now a stronger credit entity than it was not long ago, and therefore should enjoy lower rates. He stressed, “A strong nation means lower rates because it is better credit,” and said the U.S. should have the world’s lowest rates, like in the “good old days.”

He also linked rate policy to trade deficits, warning that if the Fed does not cut, he will stop trading with countries that have a trade deficit with the United States, claiming this approach is “better than tariffs.” Trump further claimed that the Supreme Court, in a tariff ruling, has clearly affirmed the president’s authority to take such action.

Trump concluded by urging the Fed Board and Chair Kevin Warsh to “be smarter” and calling on officials to “be patriots once.” He criticized high rates for putting the United States at a severely unfair competitive disadvantage and emphasized that he will not allow this situation to continue.

Analysts note that Trump equates a strong economy with lower rates, contrary to central banks’ usual logic of maintaining higher rates to curb inflation; now he ties rate cuts to trade, which not only heightens policy uncertainty but also puts the Fed’s independence under renewed scrutiny.

paras: 美股主要指數周五(4日)開盤走勢漲跌互現、道瓊指數下跌，強勁的8月非農就業數據推升聯準會(Fed)本月升息預期，並使標普500指數中止連續兩個交易日上漲走勢。對貨幣政策較敏感的2年期美債殖利率上升4個基點至4.38%，貨幣市場預估Fed 9月升息機率超過五成；美元變動不大，油價下跌，但本周仍可望收高。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近200點或近0.4%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近0.05%，標普 500 指數跌近0.1%，費城半導體指數漲近2.3%。台積電 ADR 長近1.4%。
美國8月非農就業成長遠超市場預期，促使投資人押注聯準會(Fed)最快9月升息，美股與美國公債周五同步走低，美元則轉強。
美股周五早盤下挫，標普500指數恐回吐本周部分漲幅。債市方面，對利率政策較敏感的短天期公債跌幅較重，2年期美債殖利率上升7個基點至4.40%。貨幣市場定價顯示，Fed在9月升息的機率已升至逾50%。美元隨升息預期走強，國際油價則小幅回落，但本周仍可望收高。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周五公布，8月非農就業人口增加16.2萬人，不僅高於前兩個月上修後的增幅，也超越《彭博》調查中所有經濟學家的預測；失業率則維持在4.1%，符合市場預期。
數據顯示，美國勞動市場的動能比市場原先認為更加強勁，也使投資人擔心Fed為抑制通膨，可能不得不在今年內進一步收緊貨幣政策。市場焦點將轉向下周公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，該數據可能成為Fed在9月15日至16日會議是否升息的最後關鍵。
Innovator ETFs策略師厄巴諾維茲(Tim Urbanowicz)表示，這份就業報告相當強勁，市場短期內可能採取「先反應、之後再思考」的態度。不過，待市場情緒平復後，投資人可能會意識到，勞動市場逐步恢復平衡的整體趨勢並未改變。
儘管單月就業數據明顯轉強，但Fed是否升息仍取決於通膨走勢及後續經濟數據。若下周物價數據同樣偏熱，市場對9月升息的押注可能進一步升高，並持續對股票及債券價格構成壓力。

items.title: 銀行搶著借錢給它！字節跳動豪取296億美元加碼AI
items.title_en: Banks Rush to Lend Money to It! ByteDance Secures $29.6 Billion to Boost AI
paras: 中國社群媒體巨擘字節跳動(ByteDance)已獲得近30家銀行提供的296億美元貸款，顯示在公司積極投入人工智慧(AI)之際，金融機構對其發展前景與信用能力抱持高度信心。
《路透》周五(4日)引述三名直接知情人士報導，這筆貸款是今年亞洲第二大聯貸案，僅次於軟銀集團3月為擴大投資OpenAI而籌得的400億美元，也凸顯AI產業資本需求持續攀升，卻未減弱銀行的放貸意願。
這筆美元計價貸款由花旗集團(C-US)及摩根大通(JPM-US)協調，參與銀行遍及中國、美國、歐洲與新加坡，預計不久後正式簽署。字節跳動和摩根大通未立即回應置評要求，花旗則拒絕置評。
知情人士透露，字節跳動最初設定的融資目標為200億美元，但由於銀行認購反應熱烈，最終將規模提高至296億美元，其中中國銀行業者認購金額占比超過60%。
字節跳動向銀行表示，資金將用於一般企業用途，但知情人士指出，這筆貸款實際上將主要支應公司的AI相關計畫。貸款初始期限為3年，並附帶最多延長2年的選項。
值得注意的是，這筆大型貸款並未要求字節跳動提供資產或股份作為擔保。一名消息人士表示，如此龐大的無擔保貸款相當罕見，銀行幾乎完全是憑藉字節跳動的聲譽與信用能力提供資金。
相關資金將用於中國以外的投資計畫。字節跳動目前是東南亞多座在建資料中心的主要容量承購方，透過具約束力的合約，預先承諾購買一定規模的資料中心運算容量。
研究機構Omdia首席分析師蘇廉節(Lian Jye Su)指出，字節跳動不僅在AI資料中心領域與中國大型雲端服務商競爭，也在多模態AI模型方面挑戰全球雲端巨擘，兩項布局都需要投入巨額資金，尤其OpenAI與Google(GOOGL-US)等業者正持續提高AI訓練資本支出。
字節跳動近來明顯擴大AI投資。《路透》6月曾報導，公司正與上海AI晶片業者天數智芯(Iluvatar CoreX)洽談採購推論晶片，也考慮與百度(BIDU-US)(09888-HK)達成類似交易。
這也是字節跳動繼2024年9月後，再度進入全球聯貸市場。該公司當時向約20家中國與國際銀行籌得108億美元，如今融資規模幾乎增至原來的3倍。
paras_en: Chinese social‑media giant ByteDance has secured loans totaling $29.6 billion from nearly 30 banks, showing that financial institutions have strong confidence in its development prospects and creditworthiness as the company pours resources into artificial intelligence (AI).

Reuters reported on Friday the 4th, citing three insiders, that the loan is the second‑largest syndicated facility in Asia this year, behind SoftBank’s $40 billion raise in March to expand its investment in OpenAI, underscoring the rising capital demand in the AI sector while banks remain eager to lend.

The dollar‑denominated loan is being coordinated by Citigroup (C‑US) and JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US), with participating banks spanning China, the United States, Europe and Singapore, and is expected to be formally signed soon. ByteDance and JPMorgan did not immediately respond to comment requests, while Citigroup declined to comment.

Insiders said ByteDance originally targeted a $20 billion financing, but strong subscription from banks led to an increase to $29.6 billion, with Chinese banks accounting for more than 60 % of the commitments.

ByteDance told the banks the funds would be used for general corporate purposes, but insiders noted the loan will primarily fund the company’s AI‑related projects. The loan has an initial term of three years with an option to extend up to two additional years.

Notably, the large loan does not require ByteDance to pledge assets or equity as collateral. A source said such a massive unsecured loan is rare, with banks essentially relying on ByteDance’s reputation and credit strength to provide the financing.

The proceeds will be used for investment projects outside of China. ByteDance is currently the main capacity purchaser for several data centers under construction in Southeast Asia, committing, through binding contracts, to buy a predetermined amount of compute capacity.

Omdia chief analyst Lian Jye Su noted that ByteDance not only competes with China’s major cloud providers in AI data‑center space but also challenges global cloud giants in multimodal AI models, both of which require huge capital outlays, especially as firms like OpenAI and Google (GOOGL‑US) continue to raise AI training spend.

ByteDance has recently ramped up AI investment. Reuters reported in June that the company is in talks with Shanghai AI chip maker Iluvatar CoreX to procure inference chips and is also considering a similar deal with Baidu (BIDU‑US) (09888‑HK).

This marks ByteDance’s return to the global syndicated loan market since September 2024, when it raised $10.8 billion from about 20 Chinese and international banks; the current financing is almost three times that amount.

items.title: 八月非農數據爆發擊潰鴿派 美債殖利率全線狂飆
items.title_en: August Nonfarm Data Explosion Crushes Dovish Narrative, US Treasury Yields Surge Across the Board
paras: 美國勞工部公布八月份非農就業人口暴增 16.2 萬人，遠超市場預期的 5.5 萬人。這份異常強勁的就業報告徹底打碎了本周稍早由聯準會(Fed)官員建立的偏鴿派敘事，使美債市場再度掀起拋售狂潮。
基準 10 年期美債殖利率在數據公布後瞬間跳升至 4.823%，直逼日前創下的多年高點，中斷了固定收益市場短暫的喘息機會。同時，對貨幣政策最為敏感的 2 年期美債殖利率上揚 7.6 個基本點至 4.41%，30 年期美債殖利率也微幅升至 5.252%。
就業數據驚人增長表明，儘管處於高利率環境，美國勞動需求依舊極具彈性，為聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)及鷹派決策者提供了持續緊縮政策、對抗通膨的充分空間。
對此，多位華爾街投資策略師發表了不同看法。Innovator ETFs 首席投資策略師 Tim Urbanowicz 指出，雖然市場當前呈現「先反應、後思考」的急躁作法，但隨著塵埃落定，投資人將會意識到勞動力市場重新平衡的大趨勢並未改變。
Spartan Capital Securities 首席市場經濟學家 Peter Cardillo 認為，這份報告彰顯了勞動市場的穩健，薪資年增率維持在 3.1% 的穩定區間，並無薪資通膨失控的跡象。他預測下周的 CPI 與 PPI 數據將延續七、八月的走勢，因此聯準會最終仍會維持利率不變，並表示「雖然主席華許對通膨言論強硬，但他並不急於升息」。
Annex Wealth Management 首席經濟策略師 Brian Jacobsen 對報告提出質疑，他認為七月的就業下滑只是「季節性調整的幻覺」，官方在調整上仍有待改進。他進一步警告，報告中的陰霾在於失業 27 周以上的長期失業人數增加了 15 萬 9,000 人，呈現出「不招人、不解雇」的僵局，對失業者而言依然艱難。
除了就業數據外，中東荷姆茲海峽的軍事衝突推升原油價格突破每桶 90 美元，以及科技巨頭為籌措人工智慧(AI)基建而大舉發行高評等公司債，皆持續排擠美債並推高借貸成本。
固收市場目前已將目光轉向即將公布的八月消費者物價指數(CPI)，策略師警告，若通膨再次增溫， 10 年期美債殖利率將極可能迅速突破 5.0% 的心理關卡。
paras_en: The U.S. Labor Department reported a massive surge in August nonfarm payrolls, adding 162,000 jobs—far exceeding the market’s expectation of 55,000. This unusually strong employment report completely shattered the slightly dovish narrative that Fed officials had been building earlier this week, sparking another wave of selling in the Treasury market.

The benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield jumped instantly after the data release to 4.823%, edging close to the multi‑year high set earlier, ending the brief breathing room in the fixed‑income market. At the same time, the policy‑sensitive 2‑year yield rose 7.6 basis points to 4.41%, while the 30‑year yield inched up to 5.252%.

The astonishing job growth shows that, even in a high‑interest‑rate environment, U.S. labor demand remains highly resilient, giving Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and other hawkish policymakers ample room to continue tightening and fight inflation.

In response, several Wall Street investment strategists offered differing views. Tim Urbanowicz, chief investment strategist at Innovator ETFs, noted that while the market is currently reacting impulsively—"react first, think later"—once the dust settles investors will recognize that the broader trend of labor‑market rebalancing has not changed.

Peter Cardillo, chief market economist at Spartan Capital Securities, said the report underscores a solid labor market, with the annual wage growth rate holding steady at 3.1% and showing no signs of runaway wage inflation. He predicts next week’s CPI and PPI numbers will follow the July‑August trajectory, so the Fed will likely keep rates unchanged, adding that “although Chair Warsh is tough on inflation, he is not in a hurry to raise rates.”

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, questioned the report, arguing that July’s job dip was merely a “seasonal‑adjustment illusion” and that official adjustments still need improvement. He warned that the report’s dark spot is the rise of long‑term unemployed (27 weeks or more) by 159,000, creating a “no‑hiring, no‑layoffs” stalemate that remains tough for the jobless.

Beyond the jobs data, a military clash in the Hormuz Strait has pushed crude oil above $90 a barrel, and tech giants are flooding the market with high‑rated corporate bonds to fund AI infrastructure, both of which continue to crowd out Treasuries and lift borrowing costs.

The fixed‑income market has now turned its focus to the upcoming August Consumer Price Index (CPI). Strategists warn that if inflation heats up again, the 10‑year Treasury yield could quickly breach the psychological 5.0% barrier.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流強升1.25角收31.63元 周線仍翻黑中止連5升
items.title_en: TWD: Hot‑money inflow drives a strong 0.125‑point rise to 31.63; weekly chart turns red, halting five‑week gains
paras: 美國聯準會官員放鴿，台北股匯今(4)日連袂展開反攻，在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元匯率中止連二貶走勢，終場強升1.25角，收在31.63元，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 25.925 億美元。
本周外資偏向匯出，新台幣匯率先貶後升，累計小貶 0.2 分，周線翻黑，中止連續 5 周的升值走勢。
在美股回神激勵下，台股今天展開反彈，聯發科、國巨*等權值股領軍走強，大盤終場上漲693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.72元，最高升抵 31.627 元，終場收在31.63元、強彈1.25角。
近期日圓升值主要受美日官方聯合干預匯市、日本央行升息預期升溫以及套利交易(Carry Trade)大量平倉所致，已從日前的 160 兌 1 美元一路升到 155 價位。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，日元強升0.48%，新台幣升值 0.40%，韓元升值 0.33%，星幣升值 0.16%，人民幣升值 0.1%，亞幣整體偏升。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve officials took a dovish stance, and Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets launched a counter‑attack today (4th). With hot‑money inflows, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar halted its two‑session depreciation trend, jumping 0.125 NTD to close at 31.63, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market reached US$2.5925 billion.

This week foreign investors tended toward net outflows; the TWD first depreciated then appreciated, resulting in a cumulative small depreciation of 0.2 points. The weekly chart turned red, ending a five‑week appreciation streak.

Boosted by a rebound in U.S. equities, the Taiwan stock market rallied today, with heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek and Yageo leading the gains. The index closed up 693.47 points at 46,551.13, back above its 5‑day moving average.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.72 per US$, peaked at 31.627, and closed at 31.63, a strong bounce of 0.125 NTD.

The recent appreciation of the Japanese yen is mainly due to coordinated intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities, rising expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes, and massive unwindings of carry‑trade positions, moving from around 160 yen per dollar to about 155 yen.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies today, according to central‑bank data, the yen strengthened by 0.48%, the TWD by 0.40%, the won by 0.33%, the Singapore dollar by 0.16%, the renminbi by 0.10%; overall Asian currencies were on the upside.

items.title: 台灣8月外匯存底重返6000億美元關 終結連2減 增額創16個月來最大
items.title_en: Taiwan's August Foreign Exchange Reserves Rebound to $600.19 B, Ending Two‑Month Decline and Marking the Largest Increase in 16 Months
paras: 台灣央行今(6)日公布我國8月底外匯存底，較上月底增加76.33億美元至6019.04億美元，終結連2月下滑，並創去年5月以來最大增額，而外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額共折計1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
央行外匯局局長蔡烱民說明，8月外匯存底增加主因外匯存底投資運用收益、主要貨幣對美元匯率變動，以及央行為維持外匯市場秩序進場調節。
央行統計，多數非美貨幣升值，其中，加幣升值0.91%、歐元升值0.68%、日元升值0.49%、人民幣升值0.35%，而新台幣更強升達2.51%。
蔡烱民進一步指出，8月雖有外資領股利後匯出因素，但整體淨匯入12億美元，使8月底外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額回升至1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
觀察主要國家外匯存底變化，中國為3兆4188億美元，日本1兆896億美元，瑞士為9458億美元，香港4353億美元，南韓為4174億美元，印度為5913億美元。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (the 6th) that the country's foreign exchange reserves at the end of August rose by $7.633 billion to $601.904 billion, ending a two‑month drop and representing the biggest monthly increase since May last year. Including foreign investors' holdings of domestic stocks and bonds valued at market prices on the same day, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, the total foreign‑owned assets amount to $1.861 trillion, roughly 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau Director Cai Jiong‑min explained that the August rise in reserves was mainly due to earnings from reserve investments, exchange‑rate movements of major currencies against the U.S. dollar, and the central bank’s market‑stabilisation interventions.

The bank’s data show that most non‑U.S. currencies appreciated: the Canadian dollar rose 0.91%, the euro 0.68%, the yen 0.49%, and the Chinese renminbi 0.35%, while the New Taiwan dollar strengthened even more, gaining 2.51%.

Cai added that although August saw some outflows from foreign investors repatriating dividend payments, net inflows were still $1.2 billion, bringing the market‑value of foreign‑held domestic stocks and bonds, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, back up to $1.861 trillion – about 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Looking at the foreign‑exchange reserve levels of major economies, China holds $3.4188 trillion, Japan $1.0896 trillion, Switzerland $945.8 billion, Hong Kong $435.3 billion, South Korea $417.4 billion, and India $591.3 billion.

items.title: 7月獲利亮眼 外資買超助華星光、前鼎收漲停
items.title_en: July Profits Shine as Foreign Buying Drives Hua Xing Guang and Qian Ding to Limit‑Up
paras: 摩根士丹利(大摩)近期發布報告，預測微軟、Google母公司Alphabet、亞馬遜、Meta這四家超大規模雲端業者資本支出，將從今(2026)年到明(2027)年再增加57％，台廠供應鏈預期有望受惠，今(4)日包括華星光(4979-TW)、前鼎(4908-TW)在外資挹注下，雙雙收漲停板。
觀察盤後證交所提供資訊，外資連6買華星光，本周收629元，周K連收5紅；前鼎則是由賣轉買，收224.5元，股價站上所有均線，周K連收2紅。
華星光因受惠AI高速光通訊需求升溫，自結7月獲利走強，稅後純益1.31億元、年增逾6成、EPS為0.92元，較去年同期0.56元提升。
前鼎自結7月單月獲利為2,400萬元、年增達140%，單月每股純益為0.31元。
法人表示，華星光800G ZR模組於今年第3季進入量產，出貨單價約為400G模組的數倍，加上CW Laser與EML雙產品線同步擴產，營運動能明確轉強。法人預估公司2026年全年營收有望年增38%。
前鼎則受惠市場對AI資料中心與高速光通訊模組的需求期待，公司看好光源模組外置將成CPO架構主流趨勢，標準型產品則鎖定800G與1.6T交換機應用，將在完成客戶驗證後進入量產。
法人指出，隨著AI基建軍備競賽持續升溫，全球四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)在今年資本支出合計上看7,250億美元，其中亞馬遜(AMZN-US)更預計將砸2,000億美元擴建AWS雲端基礎設施，有望視為台廠供應鏈一大利多。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley recently released a report forecasting that the capital expenditures of the four mega cloud providers—Microsoft, Alphabet (Google’s parent), Amazon and Meta—will increase by 57% from this year (2026) to next year (2027). Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain is expected to benefit, and on the 4th, both Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW) and Qian Ding (4908‑TW) hit limit‑up on foreign inflows.

Observing post‑market data from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign investors bought Hua Xing Guang for six consecutive sessions, closing at NT$629 this week with five straight red candles on the weekly chart. Qian Ding switched from net selling to buying, closing at NT$224.5, its price above all moving averages and two consecutive weekly reds.

Hua Xing Guang, buoyed by rising demand for high‑speed AI optical communications, reported strong July earnings with a post‑tax net profit of NT$131 million, up more than 60% year‑over‑year, and an EPS of NT$0.92 versus NT$0.56 a year earlier.
Qian Ding posted a July net profit of NT$24 million for the month, a 140% year‑over‑year increase, translating to a monthly EPS of NT$0.31.

Institutional investors noted that Hua Xing Guang’s 800G ZR module entered mass production in Q3 of this year, with a unit price several times that of the 400G module. Combined with simultaneous capacity expansions in its CW Laser and EML product lines, the company’s operating momentum is clearly strengthening. They project a 38% year‑over‑year revenue growth for 2026.

Qian Ding benefits from market expectations for AI data‑center and high‑speed optical‑communication modules. The company sees externalized light‑source modules becoming the mainstream trend in CPO architectures, and its standard products target 800G and 1.6T switch applications, which will move to mass production after customer validation.

Institutions pointed out that as the AI infrastructure arms race heats up, the four global cloud service providers are expected to spend a total of $725 billion on capex this year, with Amazon (AMZN‑US) alone planning to invest $200 billion to expand AWS infrastructure—an obvious tailwind for Taiwan’s supply chain.

items.title: 海悅新建案交屋陸續發酵  8月營收14.25億元年增5.4倍
items.title_en: Haiyue's New Projects Handover Gains Momentum; August Revenue Reaches NT$1.425 Billion, Up 5.4‑fold YoY
paras: 全台房產代銷龍頭海悅(2348-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收14.25億元，月減31.4%，年增5.4倍，累計1-8月營收66.19億元，年增率80.61%。預估海悅在起6月啟動台北「敦仰」等案交屋後，2026年下半年業績表現估將優於上半年。
海悅8月代銷業績持續穩健，包含 :新北市中和區「寶亞世界公舘」、「大同新紀元」、永和區「漢皇River Sky」、新莊及台南等建案開案銷況符合預期，加上台北市、新北市及新竹等多項指標建案即將公開銷售，只要符合消費者預期且買得起的房價個案，預售建案成交量可期，公司於銷售業績逐步反映，後續持續貢獻營收表現。
海悅6月啟動台北「敦仰」、新北「A 3光點」與高雄「達麗未來市」三項建案完工交屋認列，並持續挹注7、8月營收表現，且8月再啟動「微笑海悅2」與「台灣隱賦」完工交屋認列，為8月營建收入再添成長動能。
海悅下半年營運估將優於上半年，主要公司維持每年均有投資收益建案挹注代銷與營建收入，多角化經營擴張營運版圖；今年公司已啟動5項投資收益建案，年底前尚有台中市北區「達麗冶翠」案入帳，海悅透過垂直整合優勢，參與建商前期產品規劃，營運加速鞏固並擴大市占率。
paras_en: Taiwan's leading property brokerage Haiyue (2348‑TW) announced today that its August 2026 revenue was NT$1.425 billion, down 31.4% month‑over‑month but up 5.4 times year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑August reached NT$6.619 billion, an 80.61% increase from a year earlier. The company expects performance in the second half of 2026 to surpass the first half after the handover of projects such as Taipei’s “Dunyang” that began in June.

Haiyue’s August brokerage performance remained solid, with sales of projects including “Baoya World Plaza” and “Datong New Era” in Zhonghe, New Taipei, “Hanhuang River Sky” in Yonghe, as well as developments in Xinzhuang and Tainan meeting expectations. Several flagship projects in Taipei, New Taipei and Hsinchu are about to launch publicly; as long as prices match consumer expectations and affordability, pre‑sale volumes are expected to be strong, and the company’s sales results will gradually reflect this, continuing to boost revenue.

In June Haiyue began recognizing the completion and handover of three projects – Taipei’s “Dunyang”, New Taipei’s “A 3 Light Point” and Kaohsiung’s “Dali Future City” – which contributed to July and August revenue. In August it also started recognizing the handover of “Smile Haiyue 2” and “Taiwan Hidden Gift”, adding further growth momentum to construction income for the month.

Haiyue projects that its second‑half operations will outperform the first half, as the company consistently injects investment‑return projects into its brokerage and construction revenue each year, diversifying and expanding its operational footprint. This year it has launched five investment‑return projects, and before year‑end the “Dali Yecui” project in North Taichung is expected to be booked. Leveraging its vertical‑integration advantage, Haiyue participates in early‑stage product planning with developers, accelerating operations and solidifying and expanding its market share.

items.title: 每年2.7萬件受惠！台美專利電子交換今上線 加速供應鏈海外布局
items.title_en: 27,000 Cases Benefit Annually! Taiwan‑US Patent Electronic Exchange Goes Live Today, Accelerating Overseas Supply‑Chain Expansion
paras: 台美專利審查合作邁入新階段。智慧局今4日表示，於2023年11月22日我駐美國台北經濟文化代表處與美國在台協會完成簽署台美專利資料安全交換瞭解備忘錄後，智慧局與美國專利商標局雙方接續完成服務及對接資訊系統建構等籌備工作，台美專利優先權證明文件電子交換（PDX）自今（4）日起正式提供服務，為我國專利跨國審查合作啟動新的一頁。
智慧局說明，為提升跨國企業申請專利效率，各國專利主管機關無不致力於推動協力合作。自2013年起，我國已陸續與日本、韓國展開專利優先權證明文件電子交換，透過電子交換作業，簡化了兩國專利申請人主張國際優先權時須提出優先權證明文件之跨國申請程序，節省申請人提交紙本證明文件之時間及成本，亦有利於專利審查作業。

智慧局進一步說明，美國長期為我國人對外國申請專利最多的國家，每年申請件數約2萬件，另一方面，美國申請人每年向我國申請專利之件數約7千件，位居外國人在我國申請專利第2名。為進一步簡化台、美兩國申請人相互申請專利之手續，並持續拓展我國與各大專利局之審查合作，台、美兩國於2026年9月4日順利啟動專利優先權證明文件電子交換合作，日後經申請人聲明電子交換之案件，台、美兩局即可直接透過電子方式交換文件，大幅減少申請人負擔，提升我國國人向美國申請專利之便利性，亦有助美國來台申請專利，促進台美申請人雙贏。
業界指出，台美專利電子交換上線，可簡化跨國手續，大幅節省企業時間與成本。台灣具備豐沛的研發實力與高科技供應鏈，此舉不僅強化台灣全球發明樞紐的地位，更能讓半導體等核心高科技產業加快海外專利布局，顯著提升國際競爭力與智財防護網。
本次合作之各項作業說明，智慧局已公布台美專利優先權證明文件電子交換作業要點、作業說明及答客問，申請人可參見智慧局專利主題網優先權證明文件電子交換專區。
paras_en: Taiwan‑US patent examination cooperation has entered a new stage. The Intellectual Property Office announced on the 4th that after the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States and the American Institute in Taiwan signed a memorandum of understanding on Taiwan‑US patent data security exchange on November 22, 2023, the Office and the United States Patent and Trademark Office have completed preparatory work on service and information‑system integration. The electronic exchange of Taiwan‑US patent priority documents (PDX) officially began service today (the 4th), marking a new chapter in cross‑border patent examination collaboration for Taiwan.

The Office explained that to improve patent‑application efficiency for multinational companies, patent authorities worldwide are working to promote cooperation. Since 2013, Taiwan has successively launched electronic exchanges of priority documents with Japan and South Korea. The electronic process simplifies the cross‑border filing procedure for applicants claiming international priority, saving time and costs associated with submitting paper documents and also benefiting patent examination work.

The Office further noted that the United States has long been the country to which Taiwanese applicants file the most foreign patents, with about 20,000 applications per year. Conversely, U.S. applicants file roughly 7,000 patents in Taiwan annually, ranking second among foreign filers. To further simplify the mutual filing procedures between Taiwan and the U.S. and to expand cooperation with major patent offices, Taiwan and the United States successfully launched the electronic exchange of priority documents on September 4, 2026. From now on, cases where applicants request electronic exchange will have documents transferred directly between the two offices, greatly reducing applicant burden, enhancing convenience for Taiwanese filing in the U.S., and aiding U.S. applicants in Taiwan, creating a win‑win for both sides.

Industry observers say the launch of the Taiwan‑US patent electronic exchange will streamline cross‑border procedures, saving companies substantial time and cost. Taiwan’s strong R&D capabilities and high‑tech supply chain mean this move not only reinforces Taiwan’s position as a global invention hub but also enables core high‑tech sectors such as semiconductors to accelerate overseas patent positioning, markedly boosting international competitiveness and intellectual‑property protection.

The Office has published the operational guidelines, detailed instructions and FAQs for the Taiwan‑US electronic exchange of priority documents. Applicants can refer to the Patent Priority Document Electronic Exchange section on the Intellectual Property Office’s patent portal for more information.

items.title: 布局直飲且新產能投入 鮮活果汁8月營收6.49億元攀頂 年增25%
items.title_en: Fresh Juice’s August Revenue Hits NT$649 million, Up 25% YoY as It Expands Direct‑Drink Offerings and New Capacity
paras: 2026年上半年稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元的鮮活果汁-KY(1256-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收6.49億元，創單月營收歷史新高，較上月增加4.77%，年增25.55%，累計1-8月合併營收39.16億元，年增率38.88%。
鮮活果汁-KY的8月業績成長並創新高，主要在正值行業傳統旺季，飲品市場需求持續暢旺，且公司優化產品結構，近年布局並逐步斬獲預包裝「直飲」市場商機，帶動直飲產品營收比重上升，成為公司新的營運成長動能，同時，鮮活果汁-KY昆山二期智能廠投產，新增年產能2萬噸。
鮮活果汁-KY昆山二期智能廠以大幅導入自動化生產設備、智慧倉儲及物流系統，透過智慧製造提升生產效率、品質穩定度及客製化能力，進一步強化整體供應鏈韌性，繳出連續6個月營收年、月雙增佳績。
鮮活果汁-KY持續深化智慧製造與物流整合，透過生產、倉儲及配送流程優化，打造「3-5天快速出貨」的供應服務優勢，提升對客戶需求的即時反應能力，並強化客製化、小批量及多元產品的供應彈性，進一步提升營運韌性。
鮮活果汁-KY加速掌握中國新茶飲產業精細化、多元化及健康化的發展趨勢，並結合智慧製造布局，持續提升整體營運效率與市場服務能力；公司亦積極開發多元產品及拓展經銷，深化既有市場並開拓新的成長動能，持續強化核心競爭力，穩健推升整體營運表現。
鮮活果汁-KY2026年第二季營收爲15.06億元，毛利率33.44%，季增3.05個百分點，年增2.89個百分點，單季稅後純益2.05億元，季增77.39%，年增68.07%，單季每股純益5.74元。同時，鮮活果汁-KY在2026年1-6月營收26.48億元，毛利率32.12%，年增4.27個百分點，稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元。
paras_en: In the first half of 2026, Fresh Juice‑KY (1256‑TW) posted a post‑tax net profit of NT$321 million, a 1.18‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$8.98. On August 4 it announced that August revenue reached NT$649 million, a record monthly high, up 4.77% from the prior month and 25.55% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑August was NT$3.916 billion, up 38.88% YoY.

The August performance surge and new record were driven by the industry’s traditional peak season and sustained strong demand in the beverage market. The company has refined its product mix and, in recent years, has been positioning itself in the pre‑packaged “direct‑drink” market, raising the share of direct‑drink sales and creating a fresh growth engine. At the same time, Fresh Juice‑KY’s Phase II smart plant in Kunshan began operations, adding 20,000 tons of annual capacity.

The Kunshan Phase II smart plant heavily incorporates automated production equipment, intelligent warehousing, and logistics systems. Through smart manufacturing it boosts production efficiency, quality stability and customization capability, further strengthening overall supply‑chain resilience and delivering six consecutive months of double‑digit revenue growth both year‑over‑year and month‑over‑month.

Fresh Juice‑KY continues to deepen the integration of smart manufacturing and logistics, optimizing production, warehousing and distribution processes to create a “3‑5‑day fast‑shipping” service advantage. This enhances real‑time responsiveness to customer needs and reinforces flexibility for customized, small‑batch and diversified product supply, thereby improving operational resilience.

The company is accelerating its grasp of China’s emerging tea‑drink industry trends—greater refinement, diversification and health orientation—and combines these insights with its smart‑manufacturing strategy to continuously improve overall operational efficiency and market service capability. Fresh Juice‑KY is also actively developing a broader product portfolio and expanding distribution, deepening existing markets while opening new growth drivers, steadily strengthening its core competitiveness and boosting overall performance.

Fresh Juice‑KY’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$1.506 billion, with a gross margin of 33.44%, up 3.05 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.89 points year‑over‑year. Quarterly post‑tax net profit reached NT$205 million, a 77.39% QoQ increase and 68.07% YoY increase, yielding earnings per share of NT$5.74. For the January‑June period, revenue totaled NT$2.648 billion, gross margin was 32.12% (up 4.27 points YoY), net profit hit NT$321 million (up 1.18‑fold YoY), and EPS was NT$8.98.

items.title: 大銀微系統8月營收寫單月最強年增近倍 營運邁高速成長期
items.title_en: DaYin Micro Systems' August Revenue Hits Record Monthly High with Near-Double Year‑over‑Year Growth, Entering a High‑Speed Growth Phase
paras: 大銀微系統(4576-TW)今(4)日公告 2026 年 8 月最新營收，受惠於半導體與矽光子強勁需求帶動，單月營收衝上 4.27 億元，創下史上單月新高，月增 16.35%，並較去年同期大幅成長 98.05%，幾乎呈現倍數躍升，下半年營運邁入高速成長期。
大銀微系統 8 月營收一舉突破 4 億元大關，寫下新里程碑，主要成長動能來自半導體檢測與矽光子產業的爆發性需求，前 8 月累計營收達 26.7 億元，創歷年同期新高，已逼近 2025 年全年水準，年增率高達 55.75%。法人預期大銀今年全年營收將上看 40 億元。
大銀指出，旗下產品「矽光子檢測定位平台」主要供應國內半導體檢測設備大廠，該平台自第二季小量出貨後，獲得終端客戶高度滿意，8 月出現大量追加訂單，該專案交期長達 9 個月以上，能見度已一路延伸至 2027 年第二季。
此外，Stage 平台交期拉長至 3 至 4 個月，元件類交期約 3 個月，目前整體產品平均訂單能見度約半年。公司強調，下半年交貨轉趨順暢，目前仍可承接年底前交貨的訂單，歡迎客戶洽詢排單。
為緩解供不應求，大銀早已啟動總投資額約 1.5 億元的兩階段擴產計畫。第一階段已於今年 6 月完成，提升定位平台約 2 成產能，效益已反映在 7、8 月營收上；第二階段預計今年第四季至明年 2 月陸續完成，屆時產線分工調整後將可再額外增加 2 成產能。
paras_en: DaYin Micro Systems (4576‑TW) announced today (the 4th) its August 2026 revenue. Driven by strong demand in semiconductors and silicon photonics, monthly revenue surged to NT$427 million, a historic monthly peak, up 16.35% month‑over‑month and up 98.05% versus the same month last year – almost a doubling – signaling that the second half of the year is entering a rapid‑growth period.

August revenue broke the NT$400 million barrier, setting a new milestone. The main growth driver is the explosive demand from semiconductor testing and silicon‑photonics industries. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.67 billion, a record for the same period in history and close to the full‑year level of 2025, with a year‑over‑year increase of 55.75%. Analysts expect DaYin’s total revenue for the year to exceed NT$4 billion.

DaYin noted that its “silicon‑photonics testing and positioning platform” primarily supplies major domestic semiconductor testing equipment manufacturers. After a small‑scale shipment in Q2, the platform received high satisfaction from end customers, leading to a large number of additional orders in August. The project’s delivery timeline exceeds nine months, with visibility now extending through Q2 2027.

In addition, the Stage platform’s lead time has lengthened to three to four months, and component‑type items have a lead time of about three months. Overall, the average order visibility for products is roughly six months. The company emphasized that delivery is becoming smoother in the second half of the year, and it can still accept orders for delivery before year‑end; customers are welcome to inquire about scheduling.

To alleviate supply shortages, DaYin has already launched a two‑phase expansion plan with a total investment of about NT$150 million. The first phase was completed in June this year, boosting the positioning platform’s capacity by roughly 20%, a benefit already reflected in July and August revenues. The second phase is slated to be completed gradually from Q4 this year to February next year, after which re‑allocation of the production line will add another 20% capacity.

items.title: 上詮自結7月EPS虧塤0.29元較去年盈轉虧 單月虧損較Q2擴大
items.title_en: Shangquan Posts July EPS Loss of NT$0.29 per Share, Turning Profit to Loss; Monthly Loss Larger Than Q2
paras: 光通訊上詮(3363-TW)近期因有價證券多次達公布注意交易資訊，遭主管機關要求公布財務資料，今(4)日自結7月單月獲利，稅後虧損3,300萬元、稅後每股淨損0.29元較去(2025)年同期盈轉虧，單月虧損幅度甚至比今年第2季每股淨損0.22元擴大，累計今年前7月每股淨損1.47元。
上詮今日開高走低，在外資由買轉賣1,251張下，重挫半根跌停板，股價收735元，不僅跌破5日線，也連收3日黑K。
上詮8月份營收為2.04億元、月增19.7％、年增13.2%，受惠營收持續提升，公司規模經濟有望帶動產品毛利率提升。
法人指出，上詮在產品線部分，本(9)月則因光通訊CPO FAU(光纖陣列)出貨量持續提升下，有望帶起營收維持月增趨勢。
paras_en: Optical communications company Shangquan (3363-TW) recently had multiple securities disclosures requiring the regulator to publish financial information. Today (the 4th), it reported July monthly profit: after‑tax loss of NT$33 million, after‑tax loss per share of NT$0.29, turning profit in the same period of 2025 into a loss. The monthly loss per share is even larger than the Q2 loss of NT$0.22 per share this year, and the cumulative loss for the first seven months of this year is NT$1.47 per share.

Shangquan opened higher but fell lower today; after foreign investors switched from buying to selling 1,251 lots, the stock plunged half a circuit‑breaker, closing at NT$735, breaking below the 5‑day moving average and posting three consecutive black candles.

Shangquan's August revenue was NT$2.04 billion, up 19.7% month‑over‑month and 13.2% year‑over‑year, benefiting from continued revenue growth; the company's economies of scale are expected to lift product gross margins.

Institutions noted that in the product line, this September Shangquan expects revenue to maintain its monthly growth trend as shipments of optical communications CPO FAU (fiber array) continue to rise.

items.title: 全球長債殖利率飆升！結構性通膨來襲 資產配置邏輯重新洗牌
paras: 全球政府公債近期遭遇劇烈拋售，凸顯投資人對宏觀經濟環境可能轉向「通膨持續偏高」的疑慮，而各國政府難以遏制支出與主權債務增加，更進一步加深市場疑慮。
殖利率面臨的上升壓力，不只來自政府借款增加與能源價格上漲。投資人指出，全球化轉向保護主義、地緣政治緊張升高，並進一步反映在關稅、產業回流與國防支出增加等面向，都是更廣泛結構性轉變的跡象，可能導致通膨長期居高不下。
這將代表全球在金融危機後大致維持低檔且相對穩定的通膨環境將出現重大分水嶺，也將對投資人的投資組合帶來廣泛影響。
已開發國家的長天期公債殖利率，本周紛紛觸及多年或數十年高點：美國10年期公債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水準，日本10年期公債殖利率升破3%，為1996年以來首見，英國10年期公債殖利率創2008年金融危機以來新高，歐元區借貸成本的指標、德國10年期公債殖利率，也升至2011年以來未見水準。
CG資產管理公司投資組合經理Emma Moriarty說：「全球經濟的結構性特徵已經改變，現在產生的是推升通膨、而非壓低通膨的力量。」
她指出，「關稅，以及最近爆發的中東戰爭，都是這項秩序轉變最直接的表現。以為能源衝擊只是暫時現象的想法是錯誤的，因為造成這項衝擊的根本結構性變化，可能會持續相當長時間。」
「失控」公共債務終將反噬
JM Finn投資辦公室主管Jon Cunliffe表示，儘管周期性通膨壓力可能持續降溫，投資人不應假設經濟將重返2010年至2020年間那種通膨長期偏低且穩定的環境。
Cunliffe說，目前最大的未知數，在於人工智慧(AI)大幅提升生產力後，能對通膨產生多大的抑制作用——這正是新任聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)所寄望的。
Callanish Capital執行長Haig Bathgate表示，政府支出「不斷失控」，總有一天會反過來造成問題，「回顧1970年代的歷史，一旦通膨這個精靈被放出瓶子，就很難再把它塞回去。我們面臨的通膨持續時間比任何人原先想像的都更長。」

央行面臨棘手難題

各國央行在利率走勢上面臨日益複雜的挑戰。一方面，通膨仍容易受到供應面衝擊與地緣政治因素干擾，另一方面，在經濟成長疲弱之際，決策官員又不願大幅升息。
Cunliffe表示，「在這種情況下，英國央行(BOE)與Fed可能會容忍通膨暫時超標，同時觀察是否出現第二輪工資與價格效應。」
其他地區情況不同，Cunliffe指出，「歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BOJ，央行)則處於更明確的升息路徑。前者將通膨置於經濟成長之上，而後者則因經濟成長與通膨已站穩腳步，正走向貨幣政策正常化。」
在華許8月28日在美國懷俄明州傑克遜霍爾發表主題演說後，市場對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月15-16日升息的押注一度升至逾66%，遠高於演說前約35%。
ING美洲區研究主管暨全球利率與債務策略主管Padhraic Garvey表示，伊朗戰爭與高昂能源成本，為長天期公債殖利率帶來額外的上升壓力。這對歐洲而言尤其是一個迫在眉睫的問題，對亞洲以及其他地區也是如此。
Garvey說：「如果現在音樂停止，對許多發債機構而言，長天期殖利率的絕對水準看起來還算合理。但問題在於，音樂仍在轟鳴。」
他如此形容：「市場上有太多事情正在發生，而大多數壓力仍持續指向長天期利率走高。這不一定會演變成危機，但如果壓力被推得太遠，情況也可能失控。」
Garvey補充，「很難想像長天期殖利率走高的壓力會突然奇蹟般消失。」
他表示，市場對9月FOMC會議升息1碼(25個基點)的定價，已從大約五五波，轉變為三比一明顯偏向升息。

投資組合配置改變

債券殖利率飆升，也正在重新塑造投資人的投資組合配置。
Ninety One多資產收益主管John Stopford表示，通膨波動加劇，往往會提高股市與債市之間的相關性，降低債市在平衡型投資組合中的分散風險效益。
不過他指出，「實質利率上升會推高資本成本，也可能讓債券成為更具競爭力的資產類別，尤其是在股市估值看來偏高的情況下。」
Barings全球固定收益團隊執行董事Brian Mangwiro則表示，政府債券基金應採取防禦性配置，偏向存續期較短的債券。
他說：「多策略固定收益基金也可以聚焦較高收益，但同樣應偏向較短存續期。就美國而言，美國公債遭拋售以及殖利率曲線持續陡峭化，也與美元走弱的情況一致。這通常對新興市場構成利多。」

items.title: AI光通訊股重新點火！Marvell大漲4.88%、Coherent勁揚6%，資金重回資料中心高速互連
items.title_en: AI Optical Communication Stocks Reignite! Marvell Jumps 4.88%, Coherent Soars 6%, Capital Returns to Data‑Center High‑Speed Interconnects
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI光通訊股近期走勢先抑後揚。Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)與Coherent(COHR-US)先前受到高估值與同業連動賣壓影響，但隨著市場重新檢視資料中心營收展望，兩家公司今天同步大漲，顯示資金焦點再度回到AI叢集高速互連需求。
Marvell今天上漲4.88%，報219.02美元；Coherent上漲6.01%，報280.31美元。兩檔股票同步走強，Marvell負責客製化AI晶片與高速連接晶片，Coherent則供應光通訊元件及模組，分別位於AI資料中心互連架構的晶片端與光學端。
兩家公司先前一度遭到市場降溫。Marvell公布財報後，即使第2季資料中心營收年增46%，股價仍因今年以來累計漲幅一度高達184%而承壓，賣壓也擴散至Coherent與Lumentum(LITE-US)等光通訊股。不過，這波修正並未伴隨AI需求展望下滑。
相反地，Marvell管理層預期今年剩餘期間營收成長還會加快，分析師更估計，其資料中心營收第3季將年增69%，第4季增幅進一步擴大至85%。代表市場先前擔心的重點主要是估值與短線漲幅，而非AI資料中心建置放慢。
Coherent的股價轉強，則顯示市場開始把需求展望延伸至光學端。AI叢集規模擴大後，GPU與客製化ASIC之間需要更高速的資料傳輸，帶動高速光模組、雷射與光學元件需求同步增加。Marvell與Coherent同日上漲，反映資金正在重新交易整條AI高速互連供應鏈。

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI optical‑communication stocks have recently moved from a dip to a rise. Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) and Coherent (COHR‑US) were earlier weighed down by high valuations and sector‑wide selling pressure, but as the market re‑examines data‑center revenue outlooks, both companies surged today, showing that capital focus is back on the high‑speed interconnect demand of AI clusters.

Marvell rose 4.88% to $219.02, while Coherent climbed 6.01% to $280.31. The two stocks advanced together; Marvell supplies custom AI chips and high‑speed connectivity chips, whereas Coherent provides optical‑communication components and modules, representing the chip side and the optical side of AI data‑center interconnect architecture respectively.

Both companies had previously faced market cool‑down. After Marvell’s earnings release, even though Q2 data‑center revenue grew 46% year‑over‑year, the stock was pressured because its cumulative gain this year had reached as high as 184%, and the sell‑off spread to Coherent and other optical‑communication stocks such as Lumentum (LITE‑US). However, this correction was not accompanied by a downgrade in AI demand outlook.

On the contrary, Marvell’s management expects revenue growth to accelerate for the remainder of the year, and analysts project data‑center revenue to rise 69% year‑over‑year in Q3 and further to 85% in Q4. This indicates that the market’s earlier concerns were mainly about valuation and short‑term run‑up, not a slowdown in AI data‑center build‑out.

Coherent’s price rebound shows the market is extending its demand outlook to the optical side. As AI clusters scale up, faster data transfer is needed between GPUs and custom ASICs, driving up demand for high‑speed optical modules, lasers and optical components. The simultaneous rise of Marvell and Coherent reflects capital re‑allocating across the entire AI high‑speed interconnect supply chain.

items.title_en: Apple Slides Over 2% Mid‑Day as iPhone 18 May See Up to 20% Price Hike and Memory Costs Surge Nearly 400%
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)盤中下跌7.70美元或2.35%，報320.51美元。隨著記憶體價格持續上漲，新一代iPhone成本壓力受到市場關注。TrendForce預估，iPhone 18系列售價可能提高10%至20%，其中256GB Pro機型的記憶體成本較一年前增加近400%，使市場對新機換機需求轉趨謹慎。
成本上升的問題在於，蘋果能否透過硬體升級說服消費者接受更高售價。雖然iPhone 18 Pro與蘋果首款摺疊手機預計升級處理器、散熱、相機及電池續航，但TrendForce認為，目前尚未看到足以刺激大規模換機需求的突破性功能。若硬體升級幅度有限，售價卻明顯提高，新機需求可能進一步集中於價格敏感度較低的高階用戶。
摺疊手機短期內對蘋果整體出貨量的貢獻也不宜高估。TrendForce預估，2026年摺疊手機僅占全球智慧手機市場約2%。即使蘋果首款摺疊機上市後吸引高度關注，由於整體市場滲透率仍低，短期內仍難明顯改變智慧手機產品結構或成為主要換機動能。
在記憶體成本走高、硬體售價調升空間面臨考驗之際，蘋果擴大高毛利AI服務收入的重要性也隨之提高。對市場而言，接下來觀察焦點將逐步從iPhone 18的硬體規格，轉向AI功能能否創造實際付費需求，進一步形成訂閱收入，降低整體獲利對iPhone銷量與硬體升級週期的依賴。

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Apple (AAPL‑US) fell $7.70 or 2.35% in mid‑day trading, reporting at $320.51. The short‑term contribution of foldable phones to Apple’s overall shipments should not be overestimated. TrendForce projects foldables will account for only about 2% of the global smartphone market in 2026. Even if Apple’s first foldable draws strong attention, the overall market penetration remains low, making it unlikely to noticeably reshape the smartphone product mix or become a major upgrade driver in the near term.

With memory costs climbing and the room for hardware price hikes under pressure, expanding high‑margin AI services revenue becomes increasingly important for Apple. The market’s focus will gradually shift from the iPhone 18’s hardware specs to whether AI features can generate real paid demand, creating subscription revenue and reducing overall profit dependence on iPhone sales and hardware upgrade cycles.

items.title: 比特幣多頭夢醒？非農強勁引爆Fed升息警報 才站回8萬美元又被打下來
items.title_en: Bitcoin Bull Dream Wakes? Strong Jobs Data Triggers Fed Rate Hike Alarm, Reaches $80K Only to Fall Again
paras: 美國8月非農就業數據大幅超越預期，重新點燃聯準會(Fed)9月升息押注，比特幣周五(4日)一度下跌近3%，迅速回吐前一日漲幅，再度跌破8萬美元關卡。
比特幣盤中最多下跌2.8%，觸及79,197美元，與美股及債券同步承壓。美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，高於《彭博》調查中所有經濟學家的預測；失業率則維持在4.1%，顯示勞動市場動能比市場原先認為更加強勁。
截稿前，根據CoinGecko數據，比特幣交易價格在24小時內下跌0.5%，報79,432.82美元。
數據公布後，投資人提高Fed本月升息的押注，對貨幣政策較敏感的2年期美債殖利率走高，美元也隨之升值。利率上升會提高持有美元資產的吸引力，並壓抑比特幣等本身不孳息的風險資產。
這波跌勢也使比特幣能否能否否站穩8萬美元再度面臨總體經濟考驗。比特幣周四才重新突破這道關卡，當 thanks to 美債殖利率下降及美元走弱，風險資產獲得支撐。
Fed理事hlweni華 comet勒(Christopher Waller)先前表示，若通膨持續降溫，他將支持本月維持利率不變，當時一度壓低市場升息預期。然而，最新就業報告明顯轉重塑投資人對Fed政策gpt0決策gpt0前景的判斷。
Sygnum Bank投資長Fabian Dori表示，單一月份的明顯反彈仍不足以終結利率爭論，卻會為支持升息的鷹派官員提供更多 ammunition，強勁數據也驗證市場目前對9月升息機率的定價。
不過，他指出，比特幣的走勢並非只取決於Fed短期決策，美國財政部現金餘額、銀行資產負債表承受能力、私人信用創造及穩定幣供應等流動性因素，也會各自影響加密貨幣市場。
paras_en: U.S. August nonfarm payrolls vastly exceeded expectations, reigniting bets on a September Fed rate hike; Bitcoin fell nearly 3% on Friday the 4th, quickly erasing the previous day's gains and slipping back below the $80,000 barrier.

Bitcoin dropped as much as 2.8% intraday, touching $79,197, while U.S. equities and bonds were under pressure. August nonfarm payrolls rose by 162,000, above the forecasts of all economists surveyed by Bloomberg; the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, indicating labor‑market momentum stronger than the market had assumed.
At the time of writing, CoinGecko data showed Bitcoin’s price had fallen 0.5% over the past 24 hours, trading at $79,432.82.

After the data release, investors increased bets on a Fed rate hike this month, pushing 2‑year Treasury yields higher and lifting the dollar. Higher rates make dollar‑denominated assets more attractive and suppress risk assets like Bitcoin that yield no income.

This decline also put Bitcoin’s ability to stay above $80,000 under renewed macro‑economic scrutiny. Bitcoin had only reclaimed the level on Thursday, thanks to falling Treasury yields and a weaker dollar that supported risk assets.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller previously said that if inflation continued to cool he would support keeping rates unchanged this month, which had temporarily lowered market expectations for a hike. However, the latest jobs report clearly reshaped investors’ view of the Fed’s policy outlook.

Sygnum Bank’s Chief Investment Officer Fabian Dori said that a single month’s clear rebound is not enough to end the rate‑debate, but it will give hawkish officials more ammunition to support hikes, and the strong data validates the market’s pricing of a September hike probability.

He added that Bitcoin’s trajectory is not solely driven by short‑term Fed decisions; liquidity factors such as the U.S. Treasury’s cash balance, banks’ balance‑sheet capacity, private credit creation, and stablecoin supply also independently affect the cryptocurrency market.

paras_en: On September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. August employment data came out unexpectedly strong, temporarily easing market concerns about a cooling labor market, but also pushing up U.S. Treasury yields and suppressing equity valuations. The Dow Jones Industrial Average opened lower on the 4th, ending its two‑day rally; by 9:35 a.m. Eastern Time it was down 100.55 points at 53,585.56, with market focus shifting from jobs to next week’s inflation data and the Fed’s September rate decision.

With a resilient job market, the urgency for the Fed to adjust monetary policy diminishes, leading investors to focus more on next week’s inflation numbers to gauge the direction of September rate policy.

U.S. bond markets reacted first. On the 4th, long‑term Treasury yields rose as much as 5 basis points from the previous session to 4.81%, pushing bond prices down. Higher yields increase the discount pressure on equity valuations, prompting sales of some high‑multiple stocks.

Among Dow components, Nike (NKE‑US), Salesforce (CRM‑US) and American Express (AXP‑US) fell, while Chevron (CVX‑US) and McDonald’s (MCD‑US) were also under pressure; NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), Caterpillar (CAT‑US) and Cisco Systems (CSCO‑US) rose against the trend.

Nevertheless, the lower‑priced segment of the market remained supported by AI‑infrastructure themes. Memory‑chip maker Micron Technology (MU‑US) saw its stock climb after Korean media reported on the 3rd that Micron is considering doubling HBM capacity to meet strong AI demand, sparking buying in related AI‑infrastructure stocks.

This reflects a tug‑of‑war facing U.S. equities. On one hand, robust employment eases recession concerns; on the other, it lifts rates, pressuring high‑valuation stocks. At the same time, AI capital‑expenditure and HBM expansion continue to support semiconductor and AI‑infrastructure shares.

The Nasdaq Composite, which has a heavier tech weighting, opened near flat and traded around the previous close. Within the semiconductor sector, Intel (INTC‑US) and Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) attracted buyers, while Tesla (TSLA‑US) slipped.

items.title: 強勁非農幫Fed壯膽？傳聲筒：升息最後障礙只剩下周CPI
items.title_en: Strong Nonfarm Payrolls Boost Fed Confidence? The Last Hurdle to a Rate Hike Is Next Week’s CPI
paras: 美國8月非農就業數據大幅超越預期，雖然不足以直接促使聯準會(Fed)升息，卻掃除了反對本月升息的一項重要理由。素有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的《華爾街日報》記者Nick Timiraos周五(4日)撰文指出，Fed在9月15日至16日會議是否升息，如今將主要取決於下周公布的通膨數據。
Fed官員先前已表明，在今年持續按兵不動後，通膨走勢將是決定9月是否升息的首要因素。假如8月就業報告延續7月的負成長，官員便可主張，不應在勞動市場缺乏動能時進一步收緊貨幣政策。
然而，美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，遠超市場預期，7月數據也由原先減少2.3萬人上修為增加2.1萬人，使過去6個月平均就業增幅升至逾兩年最高。勞動市場疲弱因此不再是反對升息的有力理由。
Nick Timiraos強調，「移除一項反對升息的理由」，並不等於已經「建立升息的充分依據」。Fed官員目前並不認為勞動市場是主要通膨來源，薪資成長仍屬溫和，也沒有必要刻意壓低招聘活動以促使物價回落。
不過，就業與所得持續穩定成長，顯示目前利率對經濟的抑制作用可能相當有限，甚至幾乎沒有發揮效果，也使Fed必須重新思考現行政策是否足以讓通膨降溫。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，健康的勞動市場不會是他決定利率時的主要因素，但仍是評估貨幣政策是否足以降低通膨的重要背景。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周也表示，他很難將整體金融情勢形容為具有限制性。
強勁就業同時降低Fed升息的潛在代價。若下周公布的8月通膨數據促使官員傾向升息，他們採取行動時，將較不必擔心進一步緊縮會把原本脆弱的勞動市場推向惡化。
換言之，非農報告並未讓Fed非升息不可，卻讓官員少了一個不能升息的理由。隨著就業疑慮退居次要位置，下周公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)等通膨數據，將成為決定Fed本月是否出手的最後關卡。
paras_en: The U.S. August nonfarm payrolls data far exceeded expectations, and while it is not enough on its own to compel the Federal Reserve (Fed) to raise rates, it has removed a key argument against a rate hike this month. Nick Timiraos, a Wall Street Journal reporter often dubbed the “Fed’s mouthpiece,” wrote on Friday the 4th that the Fed’s decision on whether to raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting will now hinge primarily on the inflation data to be released next week.

Fed officials have previously indicated that after a year of holding rates steady, the trajectory of inflation will be the primary factor in deciding whether to raise rates in September. If the August jobs report had continued July’s negative growth, officials could argue that further tightening is unwarranted when labor‑market momentum is lacking.

However, August nonfarm employment rose by 162,000 jobs, far above market forecasts, and July’s figure was revised from a loss of 23,000 to a gain of 21,000, pushing the six‑month average job growth to its highest level in more than two years. A weak labor market is therefore no longer a strong argument against a rate hike.

Timiraos stresses that “removing one reason to oppose a rate hike” does not equate to having “sufficient grounds to raise rates.” Fed officials currently do not view the labor market as the main source of inflation; wage growth remains modest, and there is no need to deliberately suppress hiring activity to bring prices down.

Nevertheless, continued steady growth in employment and earnings suggests that the current interest‑rate stance may be exerting only limited, if any, restraint on the economy, prompting the Fed to reconsider whether its policy is adequate to cool inflation.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that a healthy labor market will not be a primary factor in his rate‑setting decisions, though it remains an important backdrop for assessing whether monetary policy is sufficient to lower inflation. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh also said last week that he finds it difficult to characterize overall financial conditions as restrictive.

Robust employment also lowers the potential cost of a Fed rate hike. If next week’s August inflation data push officials toward a hike, they can act with less concern that further tightening will push an already fragile labor market into deterioration.

In other words, the jobs report has not made a Fed rate hike inevitable, but it has removed one obstacle to raising rates. With employment concerns now secondary, the consumer‑price index (CPI) and other inflation data due next week will become the final gatekeeper in deciding whether the Fed will act this month.

items.title: Fed本月升不升息？華爾街從強勁非農看出三大關鍵
items.title_en: Will the Fed Raise Rates This Month? Wall Street Deduces Three Key Points from Strong Nonfarm Payrolls
paras: 美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，大幅超越市場預期的5.6萬人，顯示勞動市場動能比原先認為更強，也讓華爾街重新評估聯準會(Fed)本月升息的可能性。數據公布後，市場對Fed兩周後升息1碼(25個基點)的預期由52%升至59%。
華爾街分析師的解讀主要聚焦三大關鍵：第一，強勁就業是否足以促使Fed升息，還是溫和的薪資增幅仍支持按兵不動；第二，資訊與金融業就業偏弱、營建及製造業相對強勁，是否反映AI一邊取代部分白領工作，一邊透過資料中心投資創造實體產業需求；第三，亮眼數據背後仍存在季節調整、後續修正及長期失業人口增加等隱憂。
分析師對升息與否看法分歧，但較一致的結論是，下周公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)才是Fed本月利率決策的最終關鍵。8月失業率維持在4.1%，7月非農就業也由原先減少2.3萬人上修為增加2.1萬人，進一步削弱勞動市場正在快速惡化的論點；若通膨未能明顯降溫，Fed升息理由將更加充分，反之仍有繼續按兵不動的空間。

升息派與按兵不動派交鋒 關鍵仍是下周通膨

CFRA Research首席投資策略師Sam Stovall表示，就業增幅超過預期3倍，讓Fed的決策更加複雜。由於就業數據明顯改善，Fed如今有更多升息的理由，或者至少更難為維持利率不變辯護，這正是股市轉跌的原因。
Wells Fargo Investment Institute全球策略師Gary Schlossberg認為，這份報告證明美國經濟帶著相當強勁的動能度過夏季，也使下周消費者物價指數(CPI)承受更大壓力。若物價顯示通膨重新升溫，Fed在9月16日升息的可能性將進一步提高。
Natixis美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge也指出，多數決策官員原本就未對勞動市場感到擔憂，因此近期政策仍將主要由通膨主導。除非核心CPI月增率降至約0.2%，為鴿派提供繼續按兵不動的理由，否則Fed很可能在9月升息。
Harris Financial Group管理合夥人Jamie Cox則持相反看法。他認為，這份數據雖可能讓部分Fed官員主張提高短期利率，但整體資料支持維持利率不變，而不是升息。
Spartan Capital Securities首席市場經濟學家Peter Cardillo也表示，就業反彈證明勞動市場相當穩健，但平均時薪年增3.1%並未顯示薪資通膨正在惡化。若下周CPI與生產者物價指數(PPI)大致延續前幾個月趨勢，他預期Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)仍會選擇按兵不動。

產業增減透露AI衝擊 資料中心創造另一波需求

Hirtle & Co.投資長Brad Conger認為，就業報告證實華許所稱Fed暫時不必擔心充分就業目標的判斷。相較總數，產業組成更值得關注，因為其中可能已浮現AI取代人力的輪廓。
他指出，AI採用程度較高的資訊及金融業就業表現偏弱，負責建造、配置設備及供應資料中心能源的營建、製造與公用事業部門則相對強勁。這種變化可能支撐K型經濟中收入較弱勢族群的所得，意味AI一方面取代部分白領工作，另一方面也透過資料中心投資創造實體產業需求。
Gary Schlossberg表示，市場先前將部分就業疲弱歸因於企業導入AI後生產力提高，但8月報告顯示，美國經濟動能並未因此明顯消失。不過，油價上漲仍可能壓縮家庭所得並拖累消費，而目前消費支出雖不突出，仍是支撐美國經濟的重要力量。
Cresalta Investment Management投資長Josh Stevens也認為，就業數據顯示美國經濟重新朝正面方向發展。伊朗戰爭一度打亂年初動能，但目前看來部分成長力道已經回歸。若未來幾個月就業持續強勁並帶動薪資加速，才會真正引起Fed警戒。

別只看亮眼表面 修正與長期失業仍藏隱憂

Innovator ETFs首席投資策略師Tim Urbanowicz表示，市場短期內可能採取「先反應、稍後再提問」的態度，但待情緒平復後，投資人可能發現勞動市場逐步恢復平衡的整體趨勢仍未改變。
Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen則說，7月就業人口下滑如今證明只是錯覺，凸顯投資人僅根據初值交易的風險，因為數據日後可能大幅修正。地方政府教育部門先前的下降，也可能只是季節調整造成的假象。
他表示，8月總工時與總薪資均穩健成長，勞動參與率也有所改善，但單月勞動人口大增68.3萬人，令人質疑季節調整是否準確。
報告也並非毫無隱憂。失業27周以上的長期失業人口增加15.9萬人，顯示「不招聘、也不裁員」的就業市場雖對已有工作者相對有利，失業者要重新進入職場卻更加困難。
華爾街目前的共同看法是，非農報告已排除Fed因勞動市場急速惡化而按兵不動的理由，但尚不足以單獨決定利率方向。下周CPI將成為真正的決勝點：若通膨偏熱，9月升息可能成為主流預期；若物價明顯降溫，Fed仍有維持利率不變的空間。
paras_en: U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose by 162,000 in August, far exceeding the market expectation of 56,000, indicating labor‑market momentum is stronger than previously thought and prompting Wall Street to reassess the likelihood of a Fed rate hike this month. After the data release, the market’s probability that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter‑point (25 basis points) in two weeks rose from 52% to 59%.

Wall Street analysts focus on three key issues: first, whether the robust job gains are enough to push the Fed to hike rates or whether modest wage growth still supports a hold; second, whether weaker employment in information‑technology and finance versus relatively stronger construction and manufacturing reflects AI displacing some white‑collar jobs while data‑center investment creates demand in the real‑economy sector; third, the bright headline numbers still hide concerns such as seasonal adjustments, future revisions, and a rise in long‑term unemployment.

Analysts are split on whether the Fed will hike, but they largely agree that next week’s consumer price index (CPI) will be the decisive factor for the Fed’s rate decision this month. August’s unemployment rate held at 4.1%, and July’s nonfarm payrolls were revised from a loss of 23,000 to a gain of 21,000, further weakening the argument that the labor market is deteriorating rapidly. If inflation does not cool noticeably, the case for a Fed hike strengthens; otherwise, there remains room to keep rates unchanged.

The debate between hawks and doves hinges on next week’s inflation data. Sam Stovall, chief investment strategist at CFRA Research, said the job growth, which far exceeded expectations, makes the Fed’s decision more complex. With such a clear improvement in employment, the Fed now has more reasons to raise rates—or at least finds it harder to justify keeping rates steady, which is why equities have turned lower.

Gary Schlossberg, global strategist at Wells Fargo Investment Institute, believes the report shows the U.S. economy carried strong momentum through the summer, putting additional pressure on next week’s CPI. If prices indicate that inflation is heating up again, the odds of a Fed hike on September 16 will rise further.

Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, noted that most policymakers were not originally worried about the labor market, so recent policy will continue to be driven mainly by inflation. Unless core CPI’s monthly rise falls to about 0.2%, giving dovish policymakers a reason to stay on hold, the Fed is likely to hike in September.

Jamie Cox, managing partner at Harris Financial Group, takes the opposite view. He thinks the data may lead some Fed officials to argue for a higher short‑term rate, but the overall picture supports keeping rates unchanged rather than raising them.

Peter Cardillo, chief market economist at Spartan Capital Securities, said the jobs rebound shows the labor market is fairly solid, but the 3.1% year‑over‑year increase in average hourly earnings does not signal worsening wage inflation. If next week’s CPI and producer price index (PPI) roughly follow recent trends, he expects Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to stay on hold.

Industry shifts reveal AI’s impact, with data‑center demand creating a new wave of needs. Brad Conger, chief investment officer at Hirtle & Co., said the jobs report confirms Warsh’s view that the Fed does not need to worry about meeting its full‑employment goal for now. The composition of employment is more telling than the headline total because it may already show AI‑driven labor displacement.

He pointed out that employment in information‑technology and finance—sectors with higher AI adoption—was weaker, while construction, manufacturing and utilities that build, equip and power data centers were relatively strong. This shift could support income for the weaker side of a K‑shaped recovery, meaning AI replaces some white‑collar jobs while also spurring real‑economy demand through data‑center investment.

Schlossberg added that the market previously blamed weaker employment on productivity gains from AI adoption, but the August report shows that overall U.S. economic momentum has not vanished. However, higher oil prices could still squeeze household incomes and dampen consumption, and although consumer spending is not currently a standout, it remains a key engine for the U.S. economy.

Josh Stevens, chief investment officer at Cresalta Investment Management, said the jobs data indicate the U.S. economy is moving back toward a positive trajectory. The Iran conflict once disrupted early‑year momentum, but now some growth drivers appear to be returning. Only if employment stays strong and accelerates wage growth in the coming months will the Fed become truly alarmed.

Don’t focus only on the shiny surface; revisions and long‑term unemployment still hide risks. Tim Urbanowicz, chief investment strategist at Innovator ETFs, said the market may initially “react first, question later,” but once sentiment cools investors may realize that the broader trend of the labor market gradually rebalancing has not changed.

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, noted that the July dip in employment was an illusion, highlighting the risk of trading on preliminary figures because the data can be substantially revised later. The earlier drop in local‑government education employment may also have been a seasonal artifact.

He said August’s total hours worked and total wages grew robustly, and the labor‑force participation rate improved, but the single‑month surge of 683,000 workers raises questions about the accuracy of seasonal adjustments.

The report also carries concerns. Long‑term unemployment—people out of work for 27 weeks or more—rose by 159,000, showing that a “no hiring, no layoffs” market may benefit those already employed while making it harder for the unemployed to re‑enter the workforce.

Wall Street’s consensus view is that the nonfarm payrolls have removed the argument that a rapidly deteriorating labor market would force the Fed to stay on hold, but the data alone are insufficient to set the rate path. Next week’s CPI will be the true decisive point: if inflation stays hot, a September hike becomes the prevailing expectation; if prices cool markedly, the Fed still has room to keep rates unchanged.

items.title: 全球長債殖利率飆升！結構性通膨來襲 資產配置邏輯重新洗牌
paras: 全球政府公債近期遭遇劇烈拋售，凸顯投資人對宏觀經濟環境可能轉向「通膨持續偏高」的疑慮，而各國政府難以遏制支出與主權債務增加，更進一步加深市場疑慮。
殖利率面臨的上升壓力，不只來自政府借款增加與能源價格上漲。投資人指出，全球化轉向保護主義、地緣政治緊張升高，並進一步反映在關稅、產業回流與國防支出增加等面向，都是更廣泛結構性轉變的跡象，可能導致通膨長期居高不下。
這將代表全球在金融危機後大致維持低檔且相對穩定的通膨環境將出現重大分水嶺，也將對投資人的投資組合帶來廣泛影響。
已開發國家的長天期公債殖利率，本周紛紛觸及多年或數十年高點：美國10年期公債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水準，日本10年期公債殖利率升破3%，為1996年以來首見，英國10年期公債殖利率創2008年金融危機以來新高，歐元區借貸成本的指標、德國10年期公債殖利率，也升至2011年以來未見水準。
CG資產管理公司投資組合經理Emma Moriarty說：「全球經濟的結構性特徵已經改變，現在產生的是推升通膨、而非壓低通膨的力量。」
她指出，「關稅，以及最近爆發的中東戰爭，都是這項秩序轉變最直接的表現。以為能源衝擊只是暫時現象的想法是錯誤的，因為造成這項衝擊的根本結構性變化，可能會持續相當長時間。」
「失控」公共債務終將反噬
JM Finn投資辦公室主管Jon Cunliffe表示，儘管周期性通膨壓力可能持續降溫，投資人不應假設經濟將重返2010年至2020年間那種通膨長期偏低且穩定的環境。
Cunliffe說，目前最大的未知數，在於人工智慧(AI)大幅提升生產力後，能對通膨產生多大的抑制作用——這正是新任聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)所寄望的。
Callanish Capital執行長Haig Bathgate表示，政府支出「不斷失控」，總有一天會反過來造成問題，「回顧1970年代的歷史，一旦通膨這個精靈被放出瓶子，就很難再把它塞回去。我們面臨的通膨持續時間比任何人原先想像的都更長。」

央行面臨棘手難題

各國央行在利率走勢上面臨日益複雜的挑戰。一方面，通膨仍容易受到供應面衝擊與地緣政治因素干擾，另一方面，在經濟成長疲弱之際，決策官員又不願大幅升息。
Cunliffe表示，「在這種情況下，英國央行(BOE)與Fed可能會容忍通膨暫時超標，同時觀察是否出現第二輪工資與價格效應。」
其他地區情況不同，Cunliffe指出，「歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BOJ，央行)則處於更明確的升息路徑。前者將通膨置於經濟成長之上，而後者則因經濟成長與通膨已站穩腳步，正走向貨幣政策正常化。」
在華許8月28日在美國懷俄明州傑克遜霍爾發表主題演說後，市場對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月15-16日升息的押注一度升至逾66%，遠高於演說前約35%。
ING美洲區研究主管暨全球利率與債務策略主管Padhraic Garvey表示，伊朗戰爭與高昂能源成本，為長天期公債殖利率帶來額外的上升壓力。這對歐洲而言尤其是一個迫在眉睫的問題，對亞洲以及其他地區也是如此。
Garvey說：「如果現在音樂停止，對許多發債機構而言，長天期殖利率的絕對水準看起來還算合理。但問題在於，音樂仍在轟鳴。」
他如此形容：「市場上有太多事情正在發生，而大多數壓力仍持續指向長天期利率走高。這不一定會演變成危機，但如果壓力被推得太遠，情況也可能失控。」
Garvey補充，「很難想像長天期殖利率走高的壓力會突然奇蹟般消失。」
他表示，市場對9月FOMC會議升息1碼(25個基點)的定價，已從大約五五波，轉變為三比一明顯偏向升息。

投資組合配置改變

債券殖利率飆升，也正在重新塑造投資人的投資組合配置。
Ninety One多資產收益主管John Stopford表示，通膨波動加劇，往往會提高股市與債市之間的相關性，降低債市在平衡型投資組合中的分散風險效益。
不過他指出，「實質利率上升會推高資本成本，也可能讓債券成為更具競爭力的資產類別，尤其是在股市估值看來偏高的情況下。」
Barings全球固定收益團隊執行董事Brian Mangwiro則表示，政府債券基金應採取防禦性配置，偏向存續期較短的債券。
他說：「多策略固定收益基金也可以聚焦較高收益，但同樣應偏向較短存續期。就美國而言，美國公債遭拋售以及殖利率曲線持續陡峭化，也與美元走弱的情況一致。這通常對新興市場構成利多。」

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI optical‑communication stocks have recently moved from a dip to a rise. Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) and Coherent (COHR‑US) were earlier weighed down by high valuations and sector‑wide selling pressure, but as the market re‑examines data‑center revenue outlooks, both companies surged today, showing that capital focus is back on the high‑speed interconnect demand of AI clusters.

Marvell rose 4.88% to $219.02, while Coherent climbed 6.01% to $280.31. The two stocks advanced together; Marvell supplies custom AI chips and high‑speed connectivity chips, whereas Coherent provides optical‑communication components and modules, representing the chip side and the optical side of AI data‑center interconnect architecture respectively.

Both companies had previously faced market cool‑down. After Marvell’s earnings release, even though Q2 data‑center revenue grew 46% year‑over‑year, the stock was pressured because its cumulative gain this year had reached as high as 184%, and the sell‑off spread to Coherent and other optical‑communication stocks such as Lumentum (LITE‑US). However, this correction was not accompanied by a downgrade in AI demand outlook.

On the contrary, Marvell’s management expects revenue growth to accelerate for the remainder of the year, and analysts project data‑center revenue to rise 69% year‑over‑year in Q3 and further to 85% in Q4. This indicates that the market’s earlier concerns were mainly about valuation and short‑term run‑up, not a slowdown in AI data‑center build‑out.

Coherent’s price rebound shows the market is extending its demand outlook to the optical side. As AI clusters scale up, faster data transfer is needed between GPUs and custom ASICs, driving up demand for high‑speed optical modules, lasers and optical components. The simultaneous rise of Marvell and Coherent reflects capital re‑allocating across the entire AI high‑speed interconnect supply chain.

items.title: 蘋果盤中跌逾2% iPhone 18傳漲價最高20%、記憶體成本增近400%
items.title_en: Apple Slides Over 2% Mid‑Day as iPhone 18 May See Up to 20% Price Hike and Memory Costs Surge Nearly 400%
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)盤中下跌7.70美元或2.35%，報320.51美元。隨著記憶體價格持續上漲，新一代iPhone成本壓力受到市場關注。TrendForce預估，iPhone 18系列售價可能提高10%至20%，其中256GB Pro機型的記憶體成本較一年前增加近400%，使市場對新機換機需求轉趨謹慎。
成本上升的問題在於，蘋果能否透過硬體升級說服消費者接受更高售價。雖然iPhone 18 Pro與蘋果首款摺疊手機預計升級處理器、散熱、相機及電池續航，但TrendForce認為，目前尚未看到足以刺激大規模換機需求的突破性功能。若硬體升級幅度有限，售價卻明顯提高，新機需求可能進一步集中於價格敏感度較低的高階用戶。
摺疊手機短期內對蘋果整體出貨量的貢獻也不宜高估。TrendForce預估，2026年摺疊手機僅占全球智慧手機市場約2%。即使蘋果首款摺疊機上市後吸引高度關注，由於整體市場滲透率仍低，短期內仍難明顯改變智慧手機產品結構或成為主要換機動能。
在記憶體成本走高、硬體售價調升空間面臨考驗之際，蘋果擴大高毛利AI服務收入的重要性也隨之提高。對市場而言，接下來觀察焦點將逐步從iPhone 18的硬體規格，轉向AI功能能否創造實際付費需求，進一步形成訂閱收入，降低整體獲利對iPhone銷量與硬體升級週期的依賴。
